name: appclimb
description: App Store keyword research for iOS apps: Apple's official popularity, difficulty with evidence, a verdict per keyword, live rankings, and the 100-character keyword field.

interface.longDescription:
AppClimb helps iOS developers find App Store keywords their app can actually rank for, using Apple's own data.

What you can ask for:
- Keyword ideas for your app, read from its App Store listing, each with Apple's popularity score.
- A full check of up to 10 keywords: Apple's official popularity (1-100, from Apple Ads), an estimated difficulty (1-99) with the evidence behind it from the live top 10, a verdict (Worth targeting, Long-tail win, Competitive, Low demand or Dominated) with the reason, the apps ranking now, and your app's current rank.
- Where your app ranks today for up to 25 keywords (positions 1-200).
- Related searches, autocomplete and trending searches from the terms Apple publishes each week, with up to a year of Apple's weekly popularity history.
- A ready 100-character keyword field for App Store Connect, without words already in your title or subtitle.

Who it is for: indie iOS developers and small app teams doing App Store Optimization (ASO).

Limitations: popularity is Apple's relative 1-100 score, not search volume. Terms Apple does not publish only get a ceiling. Difficulty is an estimate and always comes with its evidence. Live App Store checks use the AppClimb account's daily allowance; the Apple popularity tools do not. All tools are read-only: AppClimb never changes anything in App Store Connect or in your account. Requires an AppClimb account (sign in with Google or an email link).
defaultPrompt: Find App Store keywords my app can realistically rank for.
Analyze 'habit tracker' and 'daily planner' for the US App Store.
Which App Store searches are trending in Health & Fitness this month?
